annotations.title: Rebar and wire mesh slab estimator

description: Rebar and wire mesh slab estimator — Rebar takeoff for a rectangular concrete slab: bar counts each direction on a square grid with edge cover, bar lengths, lap splices for runs longer than the stock length (default 40 bar diameters), total linear feet and weight (ASTM A615 nominal lb/ft for #3-#10), stock sticks to buy from a first-fit-decreasing cut plan with waste, tie count (intersections), chair count, and a 6x6 welded wire mesh sheet and roll alternative. Params: length and width (ft). Optional: bar (#3-#10, default #4), spacing (in, default 12), cover (in, default 3), stock (ft, default 20), lap (bar diameters, default 40), chair_spacing (ft, default 3). Offline estimate - structural reinforcement must follow the design drawings. Price: $0.003 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: eng_rebar
